summary: Code change is correct, minimal, and resolves the issue by threading fill_value through to the initial SimpleImputer. However it adds a public parameter with no docstring entry or versionadded directive, which scikit-learn requires (and numpydoc validation enforces) before merge.

issues.description: New public parameter `fill_value` is added to the signature and `_parameter_constraints` but is not documented in the class docstring, and lacks the required `.. versionadded::` directive. scikit-learn mandates docstring coverage for all public params (checked by numpydoc/test_docstring_parameters); maintainers will not merge an undocumented public parameter.

Constraint `[object]` disables real validation (mirrors SimpleImputer, so acceptable), but a brief check that np.nan is intended/supported as fill_value—explicitly requested in the issue for tree estimators—would strengthen confidence; not a code defect on its own.
